parts.text:
we're looking for a protocol that scans the patient's chart history and takes and gives me a summary of the most recent intake screening form, which is the PT051. On top of that, I want to know historical information about the patient, so what conditions the patient has. What medications the patient has taken. I want to know the recent vital signs and the lab values. And I want to know any mental health issues the patient has been experiencing. This ranges from PHQ9s to Columbia suicide risk assessments to CEWAs and other types of forms. I want the data for the conditions, medications to be displayed in tables. I want the lab values also to be displayed in tables. I want the vitals to be displayed in graphs. And I want a very legible summary of your findings on like a card.
---
I want to see an ASCII representation of that you're envisioning first. But ask me questions.

Below is the first-pass layout I’m envisioning. It prioritizes the latest PT051, current safety concerns, and clinically relevant changes while keeping source dates and provenance visible.

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ PATIENT CHART SUMMARY                                      Generated: [time] │
│ [Name / MRN]  [DOB / Age]  [Encounter]  [Allergies]  [Code Status]          │
│ Data coverage: [earliest date] → [latest date]   Sources: [systems/forms]    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ CLINICAL SUMMARY                                                             │
│ • Most recent PT051: [date/time, status, author]                             │
│ • Presenting concerns and key intake findings                               │
│ • Active conditions and relevant history                                    │
│ • Medication highlights, changes, and adherence concerns                    │
│ • Recent vital/lab trends and significant abnormalities                     │
│ • Mental-health findings and current safety considerations                  │
│                                                                              │
│ ⚠ Items requiring review: [suicide risk / withdrawal risk / critical labs]  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ MOST RECENT PT051                    │ MENTAL HEALTH & SAFETY                │
│ Form date/time: [...]                │ Latest PHQ-9: [score/severity/date]   │
│ Encounter/location: [...]            │ Columbia: [risk level/date]           │
│ Reason for intake: [...]             │ CEWA/CIWA: [score/category/date]      │
│ Symptoms/concerns: [...]             │ Other screens: [...]                  │
│ Substance-use findings: [...]        │ Ideation/plan/intent: [...]           │
│ Functional/social findings: [...]    │ Protective factors/actions: [...]     │
│ Disposition/follow-up: [...]         │ Historical score trend: [...]         │
└──────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ CONDITIONS                           │ MEDICATION HISTORY                    │
│ Condition | Status | Onset | Source  │ Medication | Dose | Route | Status   │
│-----------|--------|-------|---------│------------|------|-------|----------│
│ [...]     | Active | [...] | [...]   │ [...]      | [...]| [...] | Active   │
│ [...]     | Hx     | [...] | [...]   │ [...]      | [...]| [...] | Stopped  │
│                                      │ Start/stop dates | Indication | Source│
└──────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ RECENT VITAL-SIGN TRENDS                                                     │
│                                                                             │
│ BP       160 ┤       ●                                                      │
│          120 ┤ ●  ●     ●──●         [graph by collection date/time]        │
│           80 ┤                                                               │
│                                                                             │
│ HR/SpO₂/Temp/RR/Weight ─ separate, legible trend graphs                     │
│ Latest values and clinically significant changes labeled                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LAB RESULTS                                                                  │
│ Test | Result | Units | Reference Range | Flag | Collected | Prior/Trend    │
│------|--------|-------|-----------------|------|-----------|----------------│
│ [...]| [...]  | [...] | [...]           | H/L  | [...]     | ↑ / ↓ / stable │
│                                                                              │
│ Tabs/sections: CBC | CMP | Toxicology | Endocrine | Other                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ PROVENANCE & REVIEW                                                          │
│ Every finding links to its source form, note, result, or medication record. │
│ Conflicts, missing data, preliminary results, and uncertain extraction are  │
│ clearly marked. Summary supports—not replaces—clinician review.             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Questions

1. **What is PT051 in your organization?** Please provide a blank/sample form, field list, or screenshot with all protected health information removed.
2. Is “CEWA” the correct instrument name, or do you mean **CIWA/CIWA-Ar**? What other screening forms must be recognized?
3. What chart system and interfaces are available—Epic, Oracle/Cerner, Meditech, FHIR, HL7, database access, document APIs, or exported PDFs?
4. Are these data primarily **structured fields**, scanned documents, free-text notes, or a mixture?
5. Does “most recent PT051” mean the latest **completed/signed** form, or should drafts, amendments, and corrected forms be considered?
6. What historical window should be used for:
   - conditions and medications,
   - labs and vitals,
   - mental-health assessments?
7. Should conditions include only coded diagnoses, or also problems inferred from notes? I recommend clearly separating **documented** from **possible/inferred** conditions.
8. For medications, should the table include home medications, inpatient administrations, prescriptions, discontinued drugs, patient-reported use, and adherence?
9. How should duplicate or conflicting medication and condition records be reconciled?
10. Which lab panels matter most, and should abnormality flags come strictly from the laboratory’s encounter-specific reference ranges?
11. Which vitals should be graphed, and over what interval—last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or encounter-specific?
12. For mental-health and suicide-risk findings, should the summary display individual sensitive responses, only scores/risk categories, or both based on user role?
13. What should happen when current suicidal intent, a critical lab, severe withdrawal risk, or another urgent finding is detected—highlight only, or trigger an existing clinical escalation workflow?
14. Who will use this: physicians, nurses, behavioral-health staff, intake staff, or multiple roles? Are role-based redaction rules required?
15. Where should the result appear: chart sidebar, encounter summary, printable report, API response, or a standalone dashboard?
16. Must clinicians approve the generated summary before it is saved back to the chart? What audit, retention, and source-linking requirements apply?
Great, now show me the beautiful views that match that ASCII, but using json-render

props.title: Synthetic demonstration record
props.message: This dashboard contains illustrative data only. Production output must come from authenticated chart sources and undergo clinician review.

props.title: Clinical Summary
props.description: Concise synthesis of the latest intake and longitudinal chart history

props.title: Mental Health & Safety
props.description: Latest screening results and longitudinal safety context

props.title: Conditions
props.description: Active and historically relevant documented conditions

props.title: Medication History
props.description: Active, discontinued, and patient-reported medication records

props.title: Recent Vital-Sign Trends
props.description: Most recent documented observations with longitudinal context

props.title: Laboratory Results
props.description: Latest results with encounter-specific reference ranges and trend indicators

props.title: Abnormal results
props.content: Potassium is mildly low, AST is elevated, and ethanol is above the listed reference threshold. Interpret results in clinical context and verify against the source laboratory record.

items.title: How conflicting records should be handled
items.content: Show conflicts explicitly with dates and sources. Do not silently choose one medication, diagnosis, score, or result as authoritative.

items.title: How inferred findings should be displayed
items.content: Keep chart-documented diagnoses separate from possible conditions inferred from narrative notes. Inferences should include confidence and supporting citations.

items.title: Required clinician safeguards
items.content: The summary should support—not replace—clinical review. Urgent findings should follow organization-approved escalation workflows rather than relying on the generated summary alone.
